issues.explanation: The diff adds LOG_DAILY_DAYS=14 to .env.example but shows no daily-channel wiring to env('LOG_DAILY_DAYS', 14), so the daily retention contract is not evidenced.
There is no test for the transport-throw soft-fail path and webhook-URL scrubbing, though the task explicitly requires it.
redactArray() only checks Bearer credentials for string values, so a nested object whose string form contains Bearer credentials would be JSON-encoded without redaction.
The public send() method has no PHPDoc, though conventions require PHPDoc on touched public methods.

conventions.evidence: Follows allowed DiscordOpsAlert lane, docs/ops/logging.md:1-54 plus CHANGELOG.md:29 keep docs in sync, Pest tests added; deviation: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:50 public send() has no PHPDoc required by conventions.

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:50-83,84-192 small focused methods (formatValue/redactArray/isSensitiveKey/scrub) with clear names, consistent style, no dead code.

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:50-64 formatting plus mb_substr 1800; config/services.php:230-232 webhook_url; config/logging.php:211-217 audit channel and stack default daily; tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:341-387 formatting/truncation/redaction verified; missing: no daily channel LOG_DAILY_DAYS wiring in change.diff despite .env.example:13.

scope.evidence: .env.example:10-17, config/logging.php:200-217, config/services.php:230-232, docs/ops/logging.md:1-54, phpunit.xml:305, tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php, CHANGELOG.md:29 all serve the task; no unrelated refactors.

security.evidence: Checked app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:162-183 sensitive-key plus Bearer regex, 84-160 recursive redaction, 71-80 error logs without URL plus scrub(); no auth/escaping/mass-assignment surface; no exploitable weakness found.

simplicity.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:1-193 is lean (~150 lines) reusing Http/Log/config with no new abstractions; config and docs changes are minimal env wiring.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:321-408 covers resolvable, null/empty no-op, formatted POST, 1800 truncation, redaction, non-2xx no-leak, and audit write; missing transport-throw/scrub test for the soft-fail requirement.

review.summary: The change adds DiscordOpsAlert with formatting, truncation, redaction and soft-fail plus audit/daily logging config, docs and thorough tests. It needs changes before merging because the daily LOG_DAILY_DAYS wiring is not evidenced and the transport-exception soft-fail path has no test.
